Budgie Budgie · Personal Budget Management · Mobile · V4
The app is called Budgie, after the bird, and it keeps the mark it already had: mark() in v4-blocks.js draws it, and both the top bar and the auth ring call that one function. V4 keeps every V3 decision: five destinations, white cards over a cream page, a flat bottom bar with a lifted centre button, and WCAG 2.1 AA on every colour pair. What it adds is coverage. The September 2026 feature modules document names sixteen modules, and four of them had no screen in V3: credit cards, savings goals, alerts and reports. V4 draws those, and fills the gaps inside the modules V3 had already started. V3 stays in Odin-screens-v3.html (V3 kept its name: the app was called Odin then) for comparison. Amounts, names and dates are examples.
61 screens · 347 states375 dp · portrait onlyManrope · Phosphor47 colour pairs checked against WCAG 2.1 AA
Colour

Page #EFEBE3. Cards #FFFFFF with a #959592 border at 3.00:1. Hero #013220 to #068751 with white text. Neon #41EDA4 and #12D583 are fill only. Tone-coloured text sits on white only.

Type: Manrope
Aa

Display 30/800 for the hero amount. Title 20/800. Heading 16/700. Value 19/800. Body 14/500. Label 12/600. Caption 11/500.
PHP 124,850.00 uses tabular numerals.

Icons: Phosphor

One library. Regular weight everywhere. Fill weight on the active tab and on a selected option. Sizes 16, 20, 24 and 28. A decorative icon is hidden from the screen reader. An interactive icon carries a label.

Layout
375dp

Portrait only. Screen margin 20px. Card gap 12px. Card padding 14 to 16px. Radius 8, 12, 16, 20 and 999. Touch targets 44x44px.
Bottom bar 62dp, flat. Centre button 50dp, lifted 22dp.

V4 adds the eight refusals the feature modules document names: wrong details, too many attempts, an email already registered, an unverified email, a verified email, an expired session, Google unavailable and the service failing. None of them names which field was wrong.

2 · Onboardingthree questions, then Home4 screens · 24 states

Onboarding asks for the display name, the monthly income and the pay frequency. The other eight questions move to Settings, Profile. V4 draws them, with the review step and the money profile: the result, picking another, and asking to be assessed again.

3 · Homebalance, stat pair, recent list, charts1 screens · 14 states

A new user sees the balance card, the stat pair and the recent list. Trends, Spending and Budget Health render after seven days of transactions. V4 adds the goal, debt and alert summaries, the setup prompts, and the partial state where one failing section never hides the others.

Home 14 states changed
4 · MoneyAccounts, Income and Scheduled tabs8 screens · 51 states

One Scheduled payment record replaces the obligation, the recurring template and the Automate sheet. An auto-post switch replaces the Automate sheet. V4 adds account detail, the credit card account with its warning level, and the income automation states: posting, paused, stopped and a variable range.
